persons.name: Ratnavīrasiṃha
persons.evidence: ratnavīramṛgendramānavavaṃśajena likekha ... ratnavīrasiṃha nathaoga sampūrṇṇayā phacoya dhunakādijuterī

date.as_written: śambhubhūṣaṇaviṣṇulocanamaṅgalair yyutavatsale caitrakṛṣṇadhiṣaśa(?)vāsara vyomakeśatithau ... samvat 828 || caitrakṛṣṇacaturddaśibhṛhaspativāra

notes: The chronogram 'śambhubhūṣaṇa' (8) - 'viṣṇulocana' (2) - 'maṅgala' (8) matches the explicitly stated Newari numeral date Samvat 828. 'vyomakeśatithau' corresponds to the 14th tithi (caturdaśī).
